description: The reports the person may read, most recently changed first: id, title, newest version and a link to open it. With project_id, that project's; without it, the whole workspace's, a page at a time (pass nextCursor back as cursor), each saying whether the person pinned it; pinned_only lists just their pins. read_report_data reads a report's live data.

cursor.description: Workspace list: the nextCursor of the last answer.

pinned_only.description: Workspace list: only the reports the person pinned.

project_id.description: The project (list_projects gives ids). Leave out for every project of the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_reports
title: Reports the person can read
